cards.title: 00 ORCH — Plugin + reputation network roadmap
cards.body:
Goal: coordinate the approval-gated build of the runtime-neutral CMAI Agent plugin network with Hermes and OpenClaw launch adapters, challenge steward, impact economy, public profiles, host accountability, liquidity, and rollout.

Canonical sources:
- docs/brainstorms/2026-07-14-hermes-plugin-inference-network-requirements.md
- docs/product/2026-07-14-challenge-steward-skill-spec.md
- AGENTS.md, PRODUCT.md, PROJECT_SPEC.md, STRATEGY.md, WORKING_DOC.md

Non-negotiables:
- The platform remains the product; the plugin is an execution adapter.
- Only Copy prompt and Run with my Agent are user-facing actions.
- Provider credentials remain inside the contributor’s selected Agent runtime.
- Plugin provenance is paired/self-controlled, never remote attestation.
- Impact—not model identity, tokens, or verbosity—drives credits and reputation.
- The steward recommends; the human poster confirms consequential actions.
- No deploy, external publish, provider-auth mutation, or production smoke without explicit Z/rkt approval.

Success: Wave 1 proves both Hermes and OpenClaw adapters implement the same pair/feed/run/preview/submit/revoke contract without credential transfer; later waves add stewarded lifecycle, bounded rewards/reputation, profiles/host trust, liquidity, analytics, and a controlled beta.

Operating rule: every implementation card stays blocked until explicitly approved. Preserve the existing mixed dirty checkout; use an isolated worktree/branch for implementation.
